ApplyDataModelConfigInfo.description_en: Applies custom data model configuration information
ApplyDataModelConfigInfo.description_zh: 应用自定义数据模型配置信息

AttachData.description_en: Uploads data multiple times to the IoT blockchain trusted application system
AttachData.description_zh: 用于向IoT区块链可信应用系统多次上传数据

AttachDataWithSignature.description_en: Uploads data multiple times to the IoT blockchain trusted application system. The uploaded data must be signed by the IoT device
AttachDataWithSignature.description_zh: 用于向 IoT区块链可信应用系统多次上传数据，并且上传的数据必须由 IoT设备端进行签名

AuthorizeDevice.description_en: Grants a specified device the permission to access a blockchain
AuthorizeDevice.description_zh: 授权指定设备接入区块链权限

AuthorizeDeviceGroup.description_en: Grants devices in an IoT data source group the permission to access a blockchain
AuthorizeDeviceGroup.description_zh: 授权IoT数据源组下的设备接入区块链的权限

BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfo.description_en: Uploads summary information of phase data to the blockchain in batches and associates the data with other related phase data
BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfo.description_zh: 批量上传阶段数据的摘要信息到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据

BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfoByDevice.description_en: Uploads digest information of phase data in batches to the blockchain after IoT device signing, and optionally binds associated data from other phases
BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfoByDevice.description_zh: 通过IoT设备签名后，批量上传阶段数据的摘要信息到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据

BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfo.description_en: Uploads text-type phase data to the blockchain in batches and associates the data with other phase data
BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfo.description_zh: 批量上传文本类型的阶段数据到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据

BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfoByDevice.description_en: Uploads text-based phase data in batches to the blockchain after IoT device signing, and associates the data with other related phase data
BatchUploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfoByDevice.description_zh: 通过IoT设备签名后，批量上传文本类型的阶段数据到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据

CreateMPCoSPhase.description_en: Creates a phase in a collaboration model
CreateMPCoSPhase.description_zh: 在协同模型中创建阶段

CreateMember.description_en: Creates a consumer account by the management party
CreateMember.description_zh: 管理方创建使用方账户

DescribeCapacityInfo.description_zh: 查询资源容量统计信息

DescribeMPCoSAuthorizedInfo.description_en: Queries the permission information of an account in a collaborative model
DescribeMPCoSAuthorizedInfo.description_zh: 查询账户在协同模型中的权限信息

DescribeMPCoSPhaseInfo.description_en: Queries a unique on-chain data record and its associated data by phase ID, data unique identifier, and sequence number
DescribeMPCoSPhaseInfo.description_zh: 通过阶段标识，数据唯一标识，和序列号查询唯一一条上链数据和所关联数据

DescribeMPCoSResourceInfo.description_en: Queries the quota and usage of a business chain
DescribeMPCoSResourceInfo.description_zh: 查询业务链配额和使用情况

DescribeMemberCapacityInfo.description_en: Queries the capacity statistics information of a service consumer
DescribeMemberCapacityInfo.description_zh: 查询使用方容量统计信息

GetBlockChainInfo.description_en: Queries the blockchain metadata of uploaded data
GetBlockChainInfo.description_zh: 用于查询上传数据的区块链元信息

GetData.description_en: Confirms that previously uploaded data has been processed successfully
GetData.description_zh: 用于确认之前上传的数据已处理成功

GetDataModelConfigInfo.description_en: Queries the configuration information of a custom data model
GetDataModelConfigInfo.description_zh: 用户查询自定义数据模型配置信息

GetHistoryDataCount.description_en: Queries the number of historical data records from the IoT blockchain trusted application system
GetHistoryDataCount.description_zh: 历史数据数量查询，该API用于从 IoT区块链可信应用系统查询历史数据条数

GetHistoryDataList.description_en: Queries historical data from the IoT blockchain trusted application system
GetHistoryDataList.description_zh: 历史数据查询，该API用于从 IoT区块链可信应用系统查询历史数据

ListDependentDataModels.description_en: Queries a list of custom models
ListDependentDataModels.description_zh: 用于查询自定义模型列表

ListDevice.description_en: Queries all devices in an IoT data source group
ListDevice.description_zh: 查询IoT数据源组下的所有设备

ListDeviceGroup.description_en:
Query the list of IoT data source groups.
Users can view IoT data source groups they have registered.
Administrators can view all IoT data source groups under the project
ListDeviceGroup.description_zh:
查询IoT数据源组列表
使用方可查看自己注册的IoT数据源组
管理方可查看项目下所有的IoT数据源组

ListMPCoSPhase.description_en: Queries the list of phases that belong to a collaboration model
ListMPCoSPhase.description_zh: 查询协同模型所属的阶段列表

ListMPCoSPhaseGroup.description_en: Queries the list of collaboration models that belong to a business chain
ListMPCoSPhaseGroup.description_zh: 查询业务链所属的协同模型列表

ListMPCoSPhaseHistory.description_en: Queries a list of historical data by phase ID, data unique identifier, start time, and end time
ListMPCoSPhaseHistory.description_zh: 通过阶段标识，数据唯一标识，起始时间，结束时间，查询数据列表

ListMember.description_en: Queries the list of consumer accounts

ListMultiPartyCollaborationChain.description_en: Queries the list of multi-party task collaboration business chains
ListMultiPartyCollaborationChain.description_zh: 用于查询多方任务协同业务链列表

ListPSMemberDataTypeCode.description_en: Queries the evidence type codes under an accessor account
ListPSMemberDataTypeCode.description_zh: 查询接入方账号下存证类型编码

ListProofChain.description_en: Queries the list of notarization and traceability business chains
ListProofChain.description_zh: 用于查询存证与溯源业务链列表

LockMember.description_en: Locks a consumer account. After the account is locked, it cannot access the current blockchain
LockMember.description_zh: 锁定使用方账户，锁定账户后则账户不能访问当前区块链

ModifyMPCoSPhase.description_en: Modifies phase information in a collaboration model
ModifyMPCoSPhase.description_zh: 在协同模型中修改阶段信息

ModifyMPCoSPhaseGroup.description_en: Modifies the information of a collaborative model

RegisterDeviceGroup.description_en: Registers an IoT data source group

SetData.description_zh: 数据上传，该API用于向LTL上传数据

SetDataWithSignature.description_en: Uploads data that must be signed by the IoT device
SetDataWithSignature.description_zh: 用于上传数据，并且上传的数据必须由IoT设备端进行签名

UnAuthorizeDevice.description_en: Revokes the blockchain access permission of a specified device
UnAuthorizeDevice.description_zh: 取消指定设备接入区块链权限

UnAuthorizeDeviceGroup.description_en: Revokes the permission of devices in a specified IoT data source group to access the blockchain
UnAuthorizeDeviceGroup.description_zh: 取消指定IoT数据源组下的设备接入区块链的权限

UnLockMember.description_en: Unlocks a consumer account so that the account can access the blockchain
UnLockMember.description_zh: 解锁使用方账户，解锁后账户可访问区块链

UpdateMPCoSAuthorizedInfo.description_en: Updates the permission information of an account in a collaborative model
UpdateMPCoSAuthorizedInfo.description_zh: 更新账户在协同模型中的权限信息

UploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfo.description_en: Uploads summary information of phase data to the blockchain and optionally associates it with other phase data
UploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfo.description_zh: 上传阶段数据的摘要信息到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据

UploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfoByDevice.description_en: Uploads the digest information of phase data to the blockchain after IoT device signing, and optionally binds associated data from other phases
UploadMPCoSPhaseDigestInfoByDevice.description_zh: 通过IoT设备签名后，上传阶段数据的摘要信息到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据

UploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfo.description_en: Uploads text-type phase data to the blockchain and optionally associates it with other phase data
UploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfo.description_zh: 上传文本类型的阶段数据到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据

UploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfoByDevice.description_en: Uploads text-type phase data to the blockchain after signing by an IoT device, and optionally binds associated phase data from other phases
UploadMPCoSPhaseTextInfoByDevice.description_zh: 通过IoT设备签名后，上传文本类型的阶段数据到区块链，并同时可以绑定所关联的其它阶段数据
